@@U01860@@
Lead us speedily in our race To the deserts of vast space!

@@U01862@@
(Sings.)

@@U01863@@
See them, see, tree after tree, How thick and swift behind they drift, And crag and cliff bow down, bow low, And the long-snouted crags below, Listen, listen, they snort, they blow!

@@U01865@@
(Sings.)

@@U01866@@
Over moss and over stone, Brook and brooklet race along. What noise is that, around, above? Listen, listen! The sounds of song, Lovers’ sweet lamenting moan, Loosing their happy hearts in sighs, Voices we knew in days now flown, When to live and love were paradise? All that we hope for, all that we love, Throbs in the heart and thrills in the brain, And Echo, Echo, like the tale Of ancient days, over hill, over dale Reverberates the strain!

@@U01868@@
(Sings.)

@@U01869@@
Tu-whit! Tu-whoo! More near, more near! The jargon rises shrill and clear. The owl, the peewit, and the jay, All awake and abroad are they. Can those be salamanders there, Long in leg, and huge in paunch, Striding onward through the brakes? Behold, the great roots gaunt and bare, How from rock and sand they branch, Wreathed fantastical like snakes, In weirdest coils, which through the air They stretch to scare and to ensnare us, From wartlike knots, with life instinct,
translation:
@@U01860@@
带领我们快速驰骋，奔赴浩瀚太空的沙漠！

@@U01862@@
（唱歌。）

@@U01863@@
看看它们，看看，一棵又一棵，它们在后面漂流得多么厚实和迅速，悬崖和悬崖低垂，低低，下面长鼻子的悬崖，听，听，它们喷鼻息，它们吹气！

@@U01865@@
（唱歌。）

@@U01866@@
小溪和小溪在苔藓和石头上奔跑。周围、上方是什么声音？听着，听着！歌声，恋人甜蜜的哀叹，在叹息中失去幸福的心，我们在日子里熟悉的声音现在飞扬，什么时候生活和爱情是天堂？我们所希望的一切，我们所爱的一切， 都在心中悸动，在大脑中颤抖， 回声，回声，就像古代的故事，越过山丘，越过山谷，回响着张力！

@@U01868@@
（唱歌。）

@@U01869@@
你-惠特！嗬嗬！更近了，更近了！行话尖锐而清晰。猫头鹰、小鹩莺和松鸦，他们都醒着，在国外。那里会是蝾螈吗，腿长，肚子大，在刹车中大步前进？看哪，巨大的树根枯萎而光秃秃的，它们如何从岩石和沙子中分出，像蛇一样盘绕着梦幻般的盘绕，在最奇怪的盘绕中，它们在空中伸展以吓唬和诱捕我们，从疣状的结中，带着生命的本能，
